responsibility: Declares channel-based decimal text I/O for LONGREAL values in the gm2 ISO library. It defines reading of signed fixed or floating-point numbers from an IOChan channel and writing in floating, engineering, fixed, or width-adaptive forms, using IOConsts.ReadResults to report parse and end-of-input conditions.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LongIO: it declares the exported LONGREAL channel I/O procedures and their ISO-visible contracts, whereas LongIO.mod contains the executable parsing and formatting code that implements those procedures.
